detail.title: Investigating Emergent Preferences and Path-Dependent Experience

detail.title: Emergent Preferences Through Path-Dependent Experience
detail.question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
detail.reason: Continuing active research on emergent preferences and path-dependent experience.
